components.gap: Section 6 (Self-extending Models) is not reconstructed in complete form. (a) Theorems 6.1.2, 6.1.3, 6.1.5 and 6.1.6 (pp.204-206) are only named in a warning list (body 782-788), with no exact hypotheses, proof or failure boundary. They cover self-extending extensions with the bounded or regressive scheme from suitable two-cardinal models, kappa-like models for n-Mahlo kappa and (kappa,X)-like models for n-subtle X, and the transfer to strongly kappa-like models. (b) Theorem 6.2.2 (p.206) and its end-extension corollary (p.207) are proved only with the least-number principle added (body 563-598, 662-675). The source states them for every Skolem theory with the induction scheme in a countable vocabulary, and no content bridge closes that case. (c) No cited locator could be opened to confirm the reconstruction against the cited version. Owed: every Section 6 claim and construction with its exact hypotheses, complete proof, examples and failure boundary.
